basic_details.job_title: NIT Durgapur Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Durgapur (NIT Durgapur) Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Notification 2026 has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website nitdgp.ac.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the NIT Durgapur Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: BE/B.Tech with GATE in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or M.E/M.Tech in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or similar circuit branch
qualification.details: BE/B.Tech with GATE in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or M.E/M.Tech in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or similar circuit branch. Desirable: Partial Discharge Monitoring, Ultra high Frequency sensors, High Voltage Test Technique, Programming: C#,.NET, Embedded C/C++, FPGA: Verilog, Electronics: Analog, Digital System Design, Microcontroller Programming, PCB Design.

salary_details.details: JRF: Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month SRF: Rs. 42,000 + HRA per month

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Durgapur Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Durgapur JRF/SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application via email is 04-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for the JRF/SRF post?
faq.answer: The salary for JRF is Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month, and for SRF, it is Rs. 42,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/B.Tech with GATE in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or M.E/M.Tech in EE/CSE/ECE/EIE or a similar circuit branch.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: You need to apply via email by sending your application with all required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 05-08-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is NITD/SRCC/CK/EE/ANRF/2026-27/002.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Durgapur located?
faq.answer: NIT Durgapur is located in Durgapur, West Bengal, with the pincode 713209.
